text: My goldfish just got its learner's permit and needs me in the passenger seat.
My fridge and washing machine have declared independence. I have to attend their first cabinet meeting.
My pillow has issued a final warning: report to bed immediately or lose all blanket privileges.
The Wi-Fi is celebrating its birthday and has requested an hour of silence from all connected devices.
My shadow clocked out early. I need to catch it before it takes the last bus home.
I spilled coffee on my keyboard. Now it will only type 'one more espresso'.
The moon is short-staffed tonight. I've been called in to hold the flashlight.
My cat called an emergency board meeting. The motion to log me off passed unanimously.
My noodles have scheduled a mandatory meeting, and the agenda is getting soggy.
My social battery has reached 1%. Emergency blanket mode is now activating.
My alarm clocks have formed a union. I need to negotiate a later starting time.
A cloud outside claims it knows my primary school teacher. I need to investigate.
My brain's cache is full. Scheduled maintenance will take approximately one entire night.
The bathroom ducks are hosting a secret disco, and apparently I'm the designated DJ.
My houseplant has learned to walk and is making a break for the front door.
Reality is dropping frames. I need to step outside and install a patch.
A pigeon tapped on my window. The translation app says my dinner is getting cold.
My chair has ended its shift and refuses to provide any more competitive seating.
My headset just forecast a severe pillow storm. I'm heading to bed for shelter.
Tomorrow-me sent an email asking today-me to log off before we both regret it.
The lift in my building has started telling dad jokes. I need to talk it down.
My mouse pad has relocated to the edge of the desk and needs help with its visa paperwork.
Galactic customer service says I've exceeded my daily fun allowance and must log off for an audit.
My duvet has challenged me to a boss fight. The only available move is sleep.
Sleep has chosen me for tonight's main quest: close both eyes and remain offline.
